title.narrative: African Union Research Grants II (AURG II)

description.narrative: Improve science and technology research capacity and international collaboration between Europe and Africa, and within Africa. In addition support collaborative research and innovation activities that address critical issues facing African countries. Develop the capacity of the African Union Commission to design, implement and monitor research and innovation funding programs.

comment.narrative: Implementation of application processing was not initiated prior to project start
Procedures guiding the registration screening selection evaluation and award of grants are detailed in the Call for proposal documents and assures applicants of transparency and accountability .

The procedures are outlined in the guidelines to applicants and remain the same for the 2016 and the 2018 calls. Only the processing under the 2016 Call is reported as the process for the 2018 Call is not yet complete.
